messages:
maria-sales: Hey infra team — AcmeCorp POC kicks off Mon 3/29. They asked for a hosted API key with a temporary rate increase for the demo. Request: 50 RPS sustained, 3k RPM burstable, ~2M tokens/day estimate. 72-hour window. Need scoped key, expiration, and logging/audit. Any blockers?

jamal-eng: thanks — can you share expected model(s) and avg seq len? that affects cost and whether we can hit 50 RPS on current pool.

maria-sales: they plan to use gptj-13b-open quantized, avg seq ~256 tokens, up to 512 in worst case. Happy to get you any more detail.

eli-oncall: 50 RPS with 256 tokens is nontrivial but doable on hosted with a temporary soft-QPS lift. prefer to enforce per-key throttles + token caps. Also want a canary ramp: 10 -> 25 -> 50 over 1 hour.

sara-ops: We'll need an immediate billing/usage guard so this doesn't blow credits. Suggest a hard token cap for the 72h window (e.g., 6M tokens) and automatic rollback once hit. Also confirm TLS / audit logs enabled for the key.

jamal-eng: Ops agrees. From infra side: need 24h lead to provision scoped key and add to routing policy. We can attach a fallback model (smaller/cheaper) if latency targets fail.

maria-sales: 24h lead is fine. Customer also asked about SLA during demo — can we be explicit this is a best-effort temporary lift, not an SLA-backed Dedicated allocation.

eli-oncall: noted, we should phrase it as "demo window best-effort lift; not SLA" and implement circuit-breakers. Also adding tracing tags helps debug if they hit errors.

devex-joe: I'll prepare a ready-to-run snippet for the scoped key usage and sample rate headers. Example:
```
Authorization: Bearer <SCOPED_KEY>
X-Request-Rate-Limit: 50
```
We'll include the canary ramp script.

sara-ops: ops-bot will create the scoped key once jamal confirms provisioning timeline.

ops-bot: Scoped key created: key_scoped_8a7f... (expires in 72 hours). Attached policies: rate_limit=50rps, token_cap=6000000, canary_ramp=10/25/50.

alex-customer-success: pinging Acme to confirm demo start time and to accept token cap and ramp. I'll get them to sign the temporary Acceptable Use note.

maria-sales: perfect. jamal — can you confirm provisioning complete and we can schedule the ramp plan tomorrow morning?

jamal-eng: provisioning scheduled in 22h. I'll post when routing rules are live and share the key in the secure vault link.

maria-sales: thanks team :thumbsup: — please @maria-sales when done so I can loop in the customer.
